intro: The Filled Jade Phial holds sacred waters drawn from the moonwell near Starbreeze Village. Carried back to Dolanaar, it serves as part of an ongoing ritual to replenish the capital's central waters while young night elves learn the history of their people.

p: The druids of Darnassus rely on sacred moonwell waters drawn from across the boughs of Teldrassil to replenish their central wells. Specially crafted vessels, such as the jade phial entrusted to young adventurers by Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar, are attuned to contain these pure waters safely. By venturing eastward to the moonwell outside Starbreeze Village, initiates collect the vital water while proving their devotion to the maintenance of the World Tree.

Returning the Filled Jade Phial to Dolanaar is more than a simple errand; each replenished vessel earns another chapter in the oral history of the kaldorei. Upon receiving the full phial, Corithras Moonrage speaks of the desperate era following the Third War—the burning of Nordrassil, the loss of night elf immortality, the release of the Betrayer, and the sudden disappearance of Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage.
